title: Bayer corner interpolation reads a pixel beyond the frame
summary: indigo_stretch.cpp:60-65: red-pixel top-right Bayer interpolation includes raw[index+width+1], crossing the right edge; for a valid 2-row image this reaches past the entire allocation. Bottom-right also averages a cross-row sample at line 65. Public GRBG wrapper can place red at the top-right of an even-width frame. Next: Use only in-bounds diagonal samples at corners; verify all four patterns and corners for 2x2 and larger synthetic images.
